results.snippet: What Is Margin Trading? Before discussing isolated margin and cross margin, let's review a summary of margin trading. In margin trading, investors borrow funds from an exchange or broker to buy or sell assets for more than their own capabilities. They use the assets in their accounts as collateral to take on bigger debts and bets in the hope that they will make bigger profits.
